Onboarding_WelcomeBody: Voxora fires your sounds with one key while you play or stream, and reshapes your microphone in real time. Let's set it up in three steps.
Onboarding_WelcomePoint1: Add sounds, sort them into categories, assign hotkeys.
Onboarding_WelcomePoint2: Route audio for Discord and games.
Onboarding_WelcomePoint3: Change mic effects and theme whenever you like.
Onboarding_LanguageBody: Pick the interface language. You can change it later in Settings.
Onboarding_ThemeBody: Both themes share the same layout; only the light changes.
Onboarding_ThemeDarkHint: For dim rooms and long streams.
Onboarding_ThemeLightHint: Warm paper tones for bright rooms.
Onboarding_AudioBody: Voxora sends sound into the virtual cable; Discord and games listen on the other end. You can also hear it in your headphones.
Onboarding_TestToneHint: Plays a short tone and measures the output line.
Onboarding_DeviceBody: Windows lists the virtual cable as "CABLE Output". With your permission we rename the devices to Voxora, so Discord shows "Voxora Out Audio" in its microphone list.
Onboarding_ReadyBody: If your library is empty, start by adding your first sound. You can redo routing any time from Settings.
Onboarding_TestTonePlayed: Test tone played. If you heard it, routing works.
Onboarding_TestToneFailed: The engine was not running, so the tone could not play. Pick an output device and try again.
DeviceName_Confirm:
Windows device names will change:

• CABLE Input  →  Voxora In Audio
• CABLE Output  →  Voxora Out Audio

This requires administrator approval and the name becomes visible to every app. You may need to restart Discord afterwards.
DeviceName_NotFound: VB-Cable does not appear to be installed. Install the virtual audio cable first.

DeviceName_AlreadyNamed: The devices already carry the Voxora name.
DeviceName_UacDenied: Administrator approval was declined; device names were not changed.
DeviceName_AccessDenied: Windows refused to rename this device. Make sure you approve the administrator prompt and try again.

Guide_Subtitle: Set up the virtual cable so other people hear your sound effects
Guide_Step1Body:
1. Go to https://vb-audio.com/Cable/.
2. Click "Download" → "VB-CABLE Driver".
3. Extract the archive and run VBCABLE_Driver64.exe as administrator.
4. Restart the computer.
Guide_SetInput: Set the input device to your own microphone (e.g. {0})
Guide_Step3Body:
In Discord: User Settings → Voice & Video
• Input Device: Voxora Out Audio
• Noise Suppression, Echo Cancellation, Automatic Gain Control: OFF (Krisp breaks the effects)
Guide_AutoNote: Automatic setup: the "Auto Setup" button in Settings detects the Voxora virtual devices and routes the output to Voxora In Audio with your default microphone.
Guide_AutoReadyBody:
✓ Routing configured

• Output (cable):  Voxora In Audio
• Microphone:      {0}{1}
• Local monitor:   {2}{3}

Now set the INPUT DEVICE in Discord / Valorant
and similar apps to "Voxora Out Audio".

Note: if you select your own microphone directly in Discord
the effects will not be heard — choose Voxora Out Audio.
